correctness.rationale: For every n>=5, write C=im(B^T), Z=ker(B) of J(n,2) with coordinate l1 norm. The stabilizer of vertex {1,2} fixes no circulation (two non-internal orbit amplitudes killed by divergences at A and F); stars span cut space. The adjoint argument forces invariant projections uniquely Q=B^T(BB^T)^+B and R=I-Q. Averaging any projection over S_n does not increase l1 norm. Explicit mean-zero potential with a=(n+1)/(2n(n-1)), b=1/(2n(n-1)) solves the Laplacian edge source, and five exact edge-column types produce ||Q||=(n-2)(3n-1)/(n(n-1)) and ||R||=2(2n-5)/(n-1). INDEPENDENT rational graph Laplacian/pseudoinverse checks at n=5,6 agree. A wrong order of limiting values in the original RESULT prose (claimed 4,3 rather than the correct 3,4) was repaired in a complete RESULT.md, and the final C/O/V is for that corrected text; SLOGAN was already correct. Other minimizers are not asserted unique.
